content.json:
# Quartz telemetry overview
Anonymous product usage, reliability, and browser performance from the Quartz GitHub Pages application. User-entered timetable/task names, raw records, route IDs, local dates, exact event timestamps, and backup contents are intentionally excluded.

content.title: Overview

content.query:
pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Screen=replace_string(name, 'screen_', '')
| summarize Views=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by Screen
| order by Views desc
content.title: Screens

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Events=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by name
| order by Events desc
content.title: Feature events

content.query:
let stages = datatable(EventName:string, Stage:string, Sort:int) [
  'app_ready', 'App ready', 1,
  'run_started', 'Run started', 2,
  'run_completed', 'Run completed', 3,
  'run_report_viewed', 'Day report viewed', 4
];
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (stages | project EventName)
| summarize Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id), Events=count() by name
| join kind=rightouter stages on $left.name == $right.EventName
| project Stage, Users=coalesce(Users, 0), Sessions=coalesce(Sessions, 0), Events=coalesce(Events, 0), Sort
| order by Sort asc
| project-away Sort
content.title: Run lifecycle funnel

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Operation=tostring(customDimensions['operation']), ErrorCode=tostring(customDimensions['errorCode']), AppVersion=tostring(customDimensions['appVersion']), Build=tostring(customDimensions['buildSha'])
| summarize Count=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), LastSeen=max(timestamp) by type, outerMessage, Operation, ErrorCode, AppVersion, Build
| order by Count desc
content.title: Exceptions and handled failures

content.query:
pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize P50=percentile(duration, 50), P95=percentile(duration, 95), Views=count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Page performance

content.query:
union pageViews, customEvents, exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend AppVersion=tostring(customDimensions['appVersion']), Build=tostring(customDimensions['buildSha'])
| summarize Telemetry=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by AppVersion, Build
| order by Telemetry desc
content.title: Application versions

content.query:
pageViews
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Views=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by client_Type, client_OS, client_Browser
| order by Views desc
content.title: Browsers, operating systems, and devices

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ('reports_overview_viewed', 'run_report_viewed', 'aggregate_report_viewed')
| extend TotalOverrunMs=todouble(customDimensions['totalOverrunMs']), SkipRate=todouble(customDimensions['skipRate']), TotalBetweenTasksMs=todouble(customDimensions['totalBetweenTasksMs']), TotalInsertedDurationMs=todouble(customDimensions['totalInsertedDurationMs'])
| summarize Views=count(), AvgOverrunMinutes=avg(TotalOverrunMs) / 60000.0, AvgSkipRate=avg(SkipRate), AvgBetweenTasksMinutes=avg(TotalBetweenTasksMs) / 60000.0, AvgUnplannedMinutes=avg(TotalInsertedDurationMs) / 60000.0 by name
content.title: Aggregate report usage and measurements

content.query:
union
  (pageViews | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Count=count() by bin(timestamp, 1h) | extend Signal='Screen views'),
  (customEvents | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Count=count() by bin(timestamp, 1h) | extend Signal='Feature events'),
  (exceptions | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Count=count() by bin(timestamp, 1h) | extend Signal='Exceptions')
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Telemetry trend
